subject: Intro request: AWS co-sell with DataForge — joint account playbook
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro request: AWS co-sell with DataForge — joint account playbook

Hi Ethan —

Quick ask: AWS recently referenced a promising opportunity at DataForge (ML infra team) that looks like a fit for Redwood Dedicated + Marketplace listing. Would you be willing to intro us to the DataForge buyer / cloud lead so we can coordinate a co-sell motion?

Goal on our side: schedule a 30–45 min joint discovery to align on scope, procurement cadence, and a mutual action plan. I’ve looped Aditya (AM) and Jonas (solutions engineering) to help with the playbook.

If useful I attached a short joint playbook draft and a customer FAQ we use for marketplace onboarding. We can tailor before the intro.

Proposed next steps if you can make the intro:
- AWS intro -> DataForge buyer + procurement (E)
- Joint discovery with AD/SE (30–45m)
- Follow-up MAP (mutual action plan) with milestones, PO timing, and any security checklist items

Available windows (PST): Tue 10am–12pm, Wed 1–4pm. Happy to follow AWS lead on cadence.

Thanks very much — really appreciate any help coordinating the co-sell.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior GTM Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0194

Attachments: redwood-aws-co-sell-playbook-v1.pdf, customer-questions-DATAFORGE.xlsx
From: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@aws-partners.amazon.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro request: AWS co-sell with DataForge — joint account playbook

Vanessa, thanks for the note and the playbook.

Happy to connect — I’m looping in Maya Johnson from DataForge and copying her on the intro. Maya is the Head of Cloud Partnerships there and owns marketplace decisions. Maya, Vanessa runs our Redwood co-sell for marketplace listings and will drive a short joint discovery to scope a Dedicated + Marketplace pilot.

Maya — can you share a good time for a quick intro call this week? If it helps, Vanessa suggested Tue morning PST or Wed afternoon PST.

Ethan

--
Ethan Blake
Senior Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
ethan.blake@aws-partners.amazon.com
From: Maya Johnson <maya.johnson@dataforge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro request: AWS co-sell with DataForge — joint account playbook

Hi Vanessa / Ethan — thanks for the intro.

We are piloting a cost-effective inference stack for internal ML workloads and evaluating marketplace listings to simplify procurement across our business units. I’m primary for vendor decisions and procurement coordination is handled by Lina Park (cc’ed).

I’m available Wed 3/11 between 1:30–3:30pm PST or Fri 3/13 10–11am PST for a 30–45m call. Can you share an agenda and any pre-read?

A couple of immediate questions we’d like to cover in the discovery:
- How Redwood Dedicated integrates with AWS VPC/VPC endpoints and network isolation
- Expected SLOs and SLA terms for Dedicated vs Hosted API
- Marketplace procurement flow and invoicing cadence
- Data residency and encryption at rest / in transit

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Maya Johnson
Head of Cloud Partnerships, DataForge
maya.johnson@dataforge.com

Attachments: none
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Johnson <maya.johnson@dataforge.com>
Cc: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro request: AWS co-sell with DataForge — joint account playbook

Hi Maya — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for the windows — Wed 3/11 1:30pm PST works for our team. Agenda below (light):
- 5m intros & roles
- 10m DataForge objectives + constraints
- 15m Redwood + AWS proposed pilot architecture (dedicated pool + marketplace procurement path)
- 10m Security/compliance + contract/checklist items (SLA, data handling)
- 5m Next steps & MAP ownership

Pre-reads attached: the co-sell playbook (short), and the customer questions spreadsheet that maps to typical marketplace procurement asks. Jonas will walk the architecture and Aditya will own MAP/PO conversation.

Call invite sent for Wed 3/11 1:30pm PST (Google Meet). If Lina or anyone else from procurement wants to add topics, feel free to reply-all.

Looking forward —
Vanessa

Attachments: redwood-aws-co-sell-playbook-v1.pdf, customer-questions-DATAFORGE.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Johnson <maya.johnson@dataforge.com>, Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro request: AWS co-sell with DataForge — joint account playbook

+1 on the agenda — a couple of quick notes before Wed: 
- Jonas: please be ready to show the Dedicated capacity sizing approach for a 3-month pilot (target 1–3 p50 throughput, expected token mix).
- I’ll bring a draft MAP with milestone dates (PO, SOC2 evidence request timeline).
- Maya / Lina: if you can flag any internal procurement deadlines (fiscal cutoffs) that will help prioritize cadence.

Jonas — attaching the lightweight slide Jonas asked to iterate on; Vanessa, feel free to surface anything you want changed.

Thanks —
Aditya

Attachments: redwood-demo-arch-3month.pptx
